author: Gamers Nexus
description:
Sponsor: Montech TEN mATX PC Case https://geni.us/eoAoo
In this engineering discussion, we speak with Matt of Carbice and Jakob of Noctua about a Carbon Nanotube thermal pad solution that Noctua is co-branding. The pad requires more burn-in time than paste, but Noctua claims more than 10 years of use for this pad, avoiding the need for eventual paste replacement.

Watch our Noctua interview about the AIO and thermosiphon here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KsEP-aaUbss (review coming up later)
Watch our COLLAPSE of Personal Computing documentary: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zyQwAhppWj8
